description: D15b — narrow KMI's lineage claim from 'a vocabulary' to 'a BRIDGE', which is both more honest and more defensible. The prior-art sweep found that KMI's two claimed differentiators over OTIO — content-addressed asset identity and the asset-lineage graph — are ALREADY MODELLED elsewhere, and koine mentions neither party. **C2PA ships a cryptographically signed derivation chain** (`c2pa.ingredient` with `parentOf` / `componentOf` / `inputTo`, and hash-based 'hard bindings') backed by a real conformance program with **159 certified products** — Google (~35 entries), OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Getty, Qualcomm silicon, Sony. **MovieLabs OMC v2.8 ships a RICHER derivation vocabulary than either**: Revision / Variant / Derivation / Representation / Alternative. Shipping a third vocabulary against a signed, certified, widely deployed one and against a richer domain one is the losing move. **KMI should define PROJECTIONS onto both** — the same discipline ADR-0006 already applies to KGP (canonical form retained, projection specified and round-trip-tested) — and claim only what neither occupies. What IS unoccupied, and is the claim KMI keeps: the **analysis→knowledge bridge** — nothing in OTIO, C2PA, OMC, or IPTC connects media-analysis output to a knowledge graph — plus world-scoping. Also fold the OTIO caveat into ADR-0005, which currently reads as if OTIO were a settled 1.0 dependency: **OTIO is NOT 1.0** (v0.18.1, tagged prerelease; its '1.0 Release' milestone was due 2026-04-10 and is ~4 months late with about a third of its issues open), and `target_url` is under-specified enough that **Premiere Beta 26.1 and DaVinci Resolve 20.2 break against each other** (OTIO issue #1985) — which does not reverse the adoption but is the concrete, citable justification for KMI's explicit asset-id envelope, and belongs in the ADR's risks. Fills the OTIO / C2PA / OMC rows of docs/upstream-standards.md. Lifecycle: KMI is candidate (0.3.0); adding projections and narrowing a claim is a normative change — version bump + dated changelog, Status stays candidate, and KMI's existing re-ratification gate (it rides with the KCB media-transform re-run) is restated, not replaced. Agnostic: bind roles; C2PA/OMC/OTIO appear as named external standards, which is allowed and required — never as products koine depends on operationally. ROADMAP.md Phase F7.

userStories.title: Engage C2PA and OMC, and narrow KMI's lineage claim to what neither occupies
userStories.description: Write the prior art into the spec and re-state what KMI is claiming. This story changes what KMI SAYS about itself; US-2 defines the projections that make the narrowed claim operational.
acceptanceCriteria: specs/media-interchange.md cites C2PA's signed derivation chain concretely — `c2pa.ingredient` with `parentOf` / `componentOf` / `inputTo`, and hash-based hard bindings — and records the adoption evidence (a conformance program with 159 certified products, including Google, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Getty, Qualcomm silicon, Sony), dated so the figure ages visibly.
It cites MovieLabs OMC v2.8 and names its richer derivation vocabulary explicitly: Revision, Variant, Derivation, Representation, Alternative.

KMI's stated differentiator is NARROWED in the spec's own framing: the asset-lineage graph is no longer claimed as unoccupied ground; what KMI claims is the analysis→knowledge bridge (nothing in OTIO, C2PA, OMC, or IPTC connects media-analysis output to a knowledge graph) plus world-scoping — and the spec says the bridge role is deliberate, not a retreat.
docs/positioning.md's C2PA section and the spec text agree, and neither makes a claim the other contradicts.

userStories.title: Define the KMI → C2PA and KMI → OMC lineage projections
userStories.description: Make the bridge real. Follow the discipline ADR-0006 established for KGP: the canonical form stays koine's, each external target gets a SPECIFIED mapping, and conformance is the round-trip rather than a document shape.
acceptanceCriteria: specs/media-interchange.md specifies a field-by-field projection from KMI's asset-lineage graph onto C2PA ingredient relationships (`parentOf` / `componentOf` / `inputTo`), stating for each KMI lineage relation which C2PA relationship it maps to, and stating explicitly what does NOT survive the projection (e.g. anything C2PA has no place for) rather than implying losslessness.
It specifies the equivalent projection onto OMC v2.8's derivation vocabulary (Revision / Variant / Derivation / Representation / Alternative), again naming the lossy edges.

A new agnostic ADR (the next free number at or above 0009 — 0002–0004 are permanently reserved; check decisions/ for what chief/51's federation ADR may have taken) records the decision: KMI is a BRIDGE between C2PA and OMC rather than a third lineage vocabulary, with the alternatives considered (ship a third vocabulary; adopt C2PA wholesale; adopt OMC wholesale) and why each was rejected.

The projections' conformance obligation is stated the way KGP's is — a round-trip test, built downstream per ADR-0001, named as a follow-up rather than built here — and no schema in schemas/ gains a projection document shape.

userStories.title: ADR-0005 — record that OTIO is not 1.0, and why that strengthens the asset-id envelope
userStories.description: ADR-0005 adopted OTIO as KMI's canonical timeline model but reads as though OTIO were a settled 1.0 dependency. Record the real maturity picture in its risks, without reversing the adoption — the adoption is still right, and the interop hazard is precisely what KMI's additive layer answers.
acceptanceCriteria: ADR-0005's risks/consequences record that OTIO is NOT 1.0 — v0.18.1, tagged prerelease; the '1.0 Release' milestone was due 2026-04-10 and is roughly four months overdue with about a third of its issues open — with the observation dated.

It records the concrete interop hazard: `target_url` is under-specified enough that Premiere Beta 26.1 and DaVinci Resolve 20.2 break against each other (OTIO issue #1985), and states that this is an ACKNOWLEDGED REAL PROBLEM that KMI's explicit asset-id envelope solves — turning a hand-wave into a citation.
The adoption decision itself is unchanged and explicitly reaffirmed; the amendment is dated and marked as an amendment, not a rewrite.

docs/upstream-standards.md's OTIO row is filled with the v0.18.1 pin and its caveat, and its C2PA and OMC rows are filled with the revisions the projections in US-2 were written against; media-interchange.md bumps its version with a dated changelog entry covering all three stories, Status stays candidate, and schemas/*.json still parse.
